title: Meituan reports Q3 revenue up 21.6% YoY to ~$17.3B, above est., and an adjusted net profit of ~$285.1M, up from a ~$2.4B adjusted net loss (Ben Jiang/South China Morning Post)
summary: Ben Jiang / South China Morning Post: Meituan reports Q3 revenue up 21.6% YoY to ~$17.3B, above est., and an adjusted net profit of ~$285.1M, up from a ~$2.4B adjusted net loss — Chinese food-delivery giant Meituan reported a second consecutive profitable quarter on Friday, as the company navigates intensifying competition …
